panels.side.dma.statusMeaning: end of block: {ended, select, yes {reached} other {not reached}} · transfer under way: {moving, select, yes {yes} other {no}}

@panels.side.dma.statusMeaning.context: Secondary row under the status byte in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): what its E and T bits mean.

@panels.side.dma.readMask.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): which entries a read of the DMA port returns

panels.side.dma.readMaskTooltip: Set by $BB: bit 0 the status, bits 1-2 the counter, bits 3-4 port A, bits 5-6 port B. $7F after a reset.

@panels.side.dma.readMaskTooltip.context: Tooltip of the Read mask row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

@panels.side.dma.nextRead.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): what the next read of the DMA port returns

panels.side.dma.nextReadTooltip: The read sequence: each read of the port gives the next entry the mask enables, then the sequence starts again. $A7 restarts it, $BF makes the next read the status.

@panels.side.dma.nextReadTooltip.context: Tooltip of the Next read row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

@panels.side.dma.decoder.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): what the DMA expects as the next byte written to it

panels.side.dma.decoderTooltip: The DMA has no register select: a base byte names a register group and announces follow bytes. Until they have all come, every byte is taken as one of them.

@panels.side.dma.decoderTooltip.context: Tooltip of the Decoder row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

@panels.side.dma.decoder.ready.context: Value of the Decoder row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): the next byte written starts a new register group.

@panels.side.dma.decoder.deaf.context: Value of the Decoder row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): the DMA ignores every byte.

@panels.side.dma.sources.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): the interrupt sources the DMA lets go of the bus for

panels.side.dma.sourcesTooltip: NextRegs $CC-$CE: in hardware IM2 mode, when one of these sources requests an interrupt, the DMA lets go of the bus after its current byte so the CPU can take it.

@panels.side.dma.sourcesTooltip.context: Tooltip of the Sources row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

panels.side.dma.noStepAside: none: interrupts wait for the end of the block

@panels.side.dma.noStepAside.context: Value of the Sources row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity) when no source is enabled.

@panels.side.dma.ddmaHint.context: Hint beside the zxnDDMA section heading in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): the section exists on core 3.03 and later. Keep 'core 3.03'.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.flags.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): the zxnDDMA mode flags written by command $DF

panels.side.dma.ddma.flagsTooltip: $DF: bit 0 physical, 1 2D, 2 transparent, 3 fill, 4 Layer 2 X,Y, 5 hidden screen. Each $DF sets all of them; $C3 clears them.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.flagsTooltip.context: Tooltip of the zxnDDMA flags row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.ext.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): bits 23-16 of the ports' start addresses ($D7, $DB)

panels.side.dma.ddma.extTooltip: $D7 and $DB: bits 23-16 of port A's and port B's start addresses, used in physical mode.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.extTooltip.context: Tooltip of the Address 23-16 row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.rect.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): row length × number of rows of a 2D transfer

panels.side.dma.ddma.rectTooltip: $E3 and $E7: the row length and the number of rows of a 2D transfer.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.rectTooltip.context: Tooltip of the Rectangle row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.position.context: Secondary text of the Rectangle row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): where the 2D transfer is.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.stride.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): the distance from one row's start to the next (per port)

panels.side.dma.ddma.strideTooltip: $EB and $EF: the distance from the start of one row to the start of the next, per port.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.strideTooltip.context: Tooltip of the Stride row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.colours.context: Row label in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity): the transparent colour and the fill value

panels.side.dma.ddma.coloursTooltip: $F3: a source byte equal to it is not written (transparent mode). $F7: the value a fill writes.

@panels.side.dma.ddma.coloursTooltip.context: Tooltip of the Colours row in the DMA side-bar panel (ZX Spectrum Next, Machine info activity). Keep register names (WR0-WR6), port numbers and hex values as they are.

@panels.feature.dmaLens.bytes.context: In the summary of a .dma program shown above its first line in the Klive assembler editor (a code lens) and in the hover of its .dma lines: how many bytes the transfer moves.

@panels.feature.dmaLens.pacing.context: In the summary of a .dma program shown above its first line in the Klive assembler editor (a code lens) and in the hover of its .dma lines: the prescaler and the byte period and rate it gives with a 3.5 MHz CPU. 'T' is T-states.

@panels.feature.dmaLens.prescalerNone.context: In the summary of a .dma program shown above its first line in the Klive assembler editor (a code lens) and in the hover of its .dma lines: a prescaler too small to slow the transfer down at 3.5 MHz.

@panels.feature.dmaLens.autoRestart.context: In the summary of a .dma program shown above its first line in the Klive assembler editor (a code lens) and in the hover of its .dma lines: the block repeats when it ends (WR5).

panels.feature.dmaLens.swallowed: This line's first byte is taken as a follow byte of an earlier register group.
